products_non_negative_check.name: products_non_negative_check
products_non_negative_check.value:
("products"."low_stock_threshold" IS NULL OR "products"."low_stock_threshold" >= 0)
        AND ("products"."estimated_duration" IS NULL OR "products"."estimated_duration" >= 0)
        AND ("products"."service_duration" IS NULL OR "products"."service_duration" >= 0)
        AND "products"."staff_required" >= 0

invoices_amounts_non_negative.name: invoices_amounts_non_negative
invoices_amounts_non_negative.value:
"invoices"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "invoices"."tax_amount" >= 0 AND "invoices"."total" >= 0
        AND ("invoices"."discount_amount" IS NULL OR "invoices"."discount_amount" >= 0)
        AND ("invoices"."paid_amount" IS NULL OR "invoices"."paid_amount" >= 0)

offline_transactions_amounts_non_negativ.name: offline_transactions_amounts_non_negative
offline_transactions_amounts_non_negativ.value:
"offline_transactions"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "offline_transactions"."total" >= 0 AND "offline_transactions"."tax_exempt_amount" >= 0 AND "offline_transactions"."tax_amount" >= 0
        AND ("offline_transactions"."discount_amount" IS NULL OR "offline_transactions"."discount_amount" >= 0)
        AND ("offline_transactions"."cash_received" IS NULL OR "offline_transactions"."cash_received" >= 0)
        AND ("offline_transactions"."change" IS NULL OR "offline_transactions"."change" >= 0)
        AND "offline_transactions"."retry_count" >= 0

transactions_amounts_non_negative.name: transactions_amounts_non_negative
transactions_amounts_non_negative.value:
"transactions"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "transactions"."total" >= 0
        AND "transactions"."tax_exempt_amount" >= 0 AND "transactions"."zero_rated_amount" >= 0 AND "transactions"."tax_amount" >= 0
        AND ("transactions"."discount_amount" IS NULL OR "transactions"."discount_amount" >= 0)
        AND ("transactions"."cash_received" IS NULL OR "transactions"."cash_received" >= 0)
        AND ("transactions"."change" IS NULL OR "transactions"."change" >= 0)
        AND ("transactions"."display_total" IS NULL OR "transactions"."display_total" >= 0)
        AND ("transactions"."loyalty_points_earned" IS NULL OR "transactions"."loyalty_points_earned" >= 0)
        AND ("transactions"."loyalty_points_redeemed" IS NULL OR "transactions"."loyalty_points_redeemed" >= 0)

customers_amounts_non_negative.name: customers_amounts_non_negative
customers_amounts_non_negative.value: "customers"."total_spent" >= 0 AND "customers"."loyalty_points_balance" >= 0 AND "customers"."account_balance" >= 0 AND ("customers"."credit_limit" IS NULL OR "customers"."credit_limit" >= 0)

discounts_amounts_check.name: discounts_amounts_check
discounts_amounts_check.value: ("discounts"."min_purchase_amount" IS NULL OR "discounts"."min_purchase_amount" >= 0) AND ("discounts"."max_discount_amount" IS NULL OR "discounts"."max_discount_amount" >= 0) AND ("discounts"."usage_limit" IS NULL OR "discounts"."usage_limit" >= 1) AND "discounts"."usage_count" >= 0

attendance_location_range.name: attendance_location_range
attendance_location_range.value: ("attendance"."location_latitude" IS NULL OR "attendance"."location_latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90) AND ("attendance"."location_longitude" IS NULL OR "attendance"."location_longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

cash_drawer_sessions_amounts_non_negativ.name: cash_drawer_sessions_amounts_non_negative
cash_drawer_sessions_amounts_non_negativ.value: "cash_drawer_sessions"."opening_amount" >= 0 AND ("cash_drawer_sessions"."closing_amount" IS NULL OR "cash_drawer_sessions"."closing_amount" >= 0) AND ("cash_drawer_sessions"."expected_amount" IS NULL OR "cash_drawer_sessions"."expected_amount" >= 0) AND ("cash_drawer_sessions"."shortage" IS NULL OR "cash_drawer_sessions"."shortage" >= 0) AND ("cash_drawer_sessions"."overage" IS NULL OR "cash_drawer_sessions"."overage" >= 0) AND "cash_drawer_sessions"."total_vat" >= 0 AND "cash_drawer_sessions"."total_discounts" >= 0

recurring_booking_templates_time_check.name: recurring_booking_templates_time_check
recurring_booking_templates_time_check.value: "recurring_booking_templates"."duration" >= 1 AND "recurring_booking_templates"."start_time_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "recurring_booking_templates"."start_time_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 59

z_readings_amounts_non_negative.name: z_readings_amounts_non_negative
z_readings_amounts_non_negative.value: "z_readings"."beginning_gt" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."ending_gt" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."gross_sales" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."vatable_sales" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."vat_amount" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."vat_exempt_sales" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."zero_rated_sales" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."discount_total" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."transaction_count" >= 0 AND "z_readings"."void_count" >= 0

subscriptions_payment_method_expiry_chec.name: subscriptions_payment_method_expiry_check
subscriptions_payment_method_expiry_chec.value: ("subscriptions"."payment_method_expiry_month" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."payment_method_expiry_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12) AND ("subscriptions"."payment_method_expiry_year" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."payment_method_expiry_year" BETWEEN 2024 AND 2050)
